title: Not worth $25
text: It was nice to try different products but a lot of them I didn’t wanna use ... like I’m picky about what’s in my shampoos/conditioners as I should especially since I have curl type 3 hair, there were conditioners with cones in them.. (can’t use that) .. deodorant with aluminum which I don’t use .. & other things I don’t use so I had to give or throw away.. there were only 2 full sized hair products in there.. and lashes , deodorant (can’t use) and the others were sample packets.. I think their price should be lower or do better with the product options.. it’s better subscribing to boxy charm in my opinion. $25 monthly but you receive high end products and I get to choose one product to put in each box 💅🏼
label: neutral
